profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google | AI4Code
profile.summary:
As a software engineer at Google, I leverage my 15+ years of experience to design and develop data engineering and AI/ML solutions for large-scale and complex problems. I work with cutting-edge technologies such as Gemini-based LLMs, telemetry-based optimization opportunity discovery, and PB-scale streaming data processing engines.

I also have a strong background in full stack development, cloud computing, big data analytics, performance debugging, and customer interaction. I have successfully delivered projects using various languages and frameworks, such as Java, Python, Go, Kotlin, C, JavaScript, Node.js, Typescript, Bash, SQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Unix/Linux, ZFS, DTrace, Angular2, React.js, Spring, Django, NumPy, Pandas, and PyTorch. I have also demonstrated my leadership and collaboration skills by leading a team of engineers and partnering with other teams and stakeholders. My goal is to create innovative and impactful solutions that delight users and drive business value.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Data engineering for Gemini-based fine-tuned LLM.
- LLM code optimization frameworks and infrastructure.
- Data engineering and full stack development for telemetry-based optimization opportunity discovery.
- Team lead for financial & datacenter resource simulation framework.

positions.title: Technologist, Software Development
positions.description:
Full Stack Developer for IntelliFlash storage array.
Development Projects include:
  - Cloud-based big data analytics and machine learning for systems telemetry data (PyTorch)
  - Hyper-scale AWS EC2 job manager scaling to thousands of EC2 instances (Golang)
  - Cloud-Backup: S3 snapshot store for IntelliFlash storage arrays (Java, AWS)
  - Production performance monitoring and data visualization UIs (Java, Angular2, Typescript)
  - Multi-System management framework and UI (Java, Kotlin, Angular2, Typescript)
  - DevOps tools for VMWare-based test system automation (Python)

positions.title: Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Tools and Software Development for IntelliFlash Storage Array
Projects Included:
  - Production remote access and support solution (Node.js / Python / JQuery / AWS)
  - Corpus of DTrace-based performance debugging tools for a Solaris-based OS and ZFS (Bash / Dtrace)
  - Tools for automated deployment of performance debugging scripts (Bash)
  - Framework for processing and charting results of performance debugging (Python / DJango)
  - Customer-facing and on-site assistance in critical outage situations

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Technology Lead
positions.description:
Sustaining Developer for ZFS Storage Appliance
Technology lead for a team of engineers
Projects Included:
  - Sustaining ZFS Storage Appliance performance monitoring code (C, JavaScript)
  - UI Features for performance monitoring UI (JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas)
  - Assisted in resolving customer issues and validating POC architectures

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- New product development for a Hierarchical Storage Manager / Archiver for ZFS
- Designed storage product prototypes

positions.title: Software Engineer - Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and developed software to support the agile process
- Extensive work with C# and the .NET library
- Developed test automation fixtures
